articles.title: A Black Hole Just Ate a Star — and Scientists Caught It Happening!
articles.summary: A space telescope spotted a black hole tearing apart a white dwarf star. It's the first time scientists have seen this kind of feeding event. The flash was one of the brightest ever recorded.

articles.title: Slowing Ships Down Saves Giant Whales — But Will the Rule Stay?
articles.summary: Since 2008, a rule has made ships slow down to protect endangered right whales. Now, NOAA is questioning if the rule is still needed. Only about 380 of these whales are left.

articles.title: Did Earth Send Life to Venus? A New Study Says Maybe!
articles.summary: Scientists think tiny life forms from Earth could have hitched a ride to Venus on space rocks. Their model shows billions of cells may have reached Venus's clouds over time.
